messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout starting in 5m for service=llm-routing, image=redwood/llm-route:v2.3.1. Planned feature-flag changes: llmroute_opt_in -> 10% -> 25% over 30m. Change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Release notes draft attached. @sam @maya

sam: holding on the ramp until we confirm no perf regressions in last staging run. saw p99 token latency +18% during the final smoke run.

maya: ack, pulling logs now. can someone share the exact staging commit hash and config?

deploy-bot: Staging run info: commit=ab3f9e, env=staging-3, batcher_config=continuous-128, quantize_profile=fp16-fast.

maya: thanks. looks like the batcher change might be the culprit. @ops-ash can you pause the canary? prefer to keep flag at 0% until we validate.

ops-ash: paused automatic ramp in console, set llmroute_opt_in=0% for all canaries. noted in changelog: "soft-pause for llm-route canary due to latency variance" :warning:

qa-lin: running targeted smoke tests now against v2.3.1 in staging-3 (full request replay). ETA ~12m. will post results here.

sam: if smoke passes we can consider a slow ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 10% over 90m with close p99 monitoring. otherwise rollback to v2.3.0 and pin routing.

maya: creating a quick rollback runbook and pin command:
```
# pin traffic to previous version
redwoodctl route pin --service llm-routing --version v2.3.0 --reason "rollout regression"
```
Posting release note snippet to #release-notes: "Canary paused: llm-route v2.3.1 ramp delayed due to p99 latency spike; team investigating. No user-facing impact."

ops-ash: added release-note and annotated deploybot ticket. also added monitor alert for p99 > baseline +10%.

qa-lin: smoke finished, two failing tests related to cold-start token latency spikes. attaching sample traces.

sahil: looks like KV cache warmup in the new image is slower. we can add a warmup prefetch in the rollout config and re-run smoke.

maya: agree. plan: keep flag at 0%, add warmup tweak to deploy config, re-run staging smoke, then proceed with conservative ramp (1% -> 5% over 60m). if any regression, execute rollback using runbook.

sam: good plan. @deploy-bot hold the queued rollout until manually unpaused. ops-ash, can you coordinate release notes for PM?

ops-ash: on it, pinged PM and updated the ticket. deploy-bot: acknowledged hold. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged. Canary queued and will not start until manual resume by @maya or @sam. Logs and artifacts saved at https://artifacts.redwood.internal/deploys/1768005555

maya: I'll re-run smoke after warmup tweak and post results. reopening thread when ready. thx all. :pray:
